# Contract: the language catalog and the packs (spec 080)

## `packs/languages.tsv` (generated by `scripts/update-language-catalog.py`, committed)

One line per direction, tab-separated:

```text
code  direction  quality  tag  speech  registry folder  model  model sha256  shortlist  shortlist sha256  vocab(s)  vocab sha256(s)
ja    en-ja      full     ja   ja-JP   models/en-ja/…/exported  model.enja.intgemm.alphas.bin  …  lex.50.50.enja.s2t.bin  …  srcvocab.enja.spm,trgvocab.enja.spm  …,…
```

- `quality` is `basic` for a `tiny` direction; a language is basic when either line is.
- The same file drives `settings.gradle.kts` (one pack module per code), `androidApp`'s `assetPacks`,
  `scripts/fetch-language-packs.sh` and the generated Kotlin catalog (`LanguageCatalog`).

## `pack.json` (spec 012 contracts/pack-format.md), one change

A direction may give `"sourceVocab"` and `"targetVocab"` instead of `"vocab"`; `PackDescription` reads either, and a
direction with neither is damaged (spec 012 T072).

## `scripts/fetch-language-packs.sh`

- `--languages pt,es` (the default) or `--all`.
- Every file is checked against its SHA-256 in `packs/languages.tsv`; a mismatch stops the script.

## Ports

- `LanguageNames` (new, `core/domain`): `nameOf(tag, appLanguage)`, `ownName(tag)`. Android in `core/platform`
  (`Locale`), bound in `AppModule`; fake in tests (`"Name(tag)"`).
- `ContentPacks` (spec 012): unchanged; `PlayContentPacks` gets the catalog's 53 packs.
